passage.label: By dawn; ten nights; even number odd; night passes; oath sufficient one perception; considered Lord dealt Aad; Iram lofty pillars; likes never created land; Thamud carved rocks valley; Pharaoh owner stakes; oppressed within lands; increased therein corruption; Lord poured scourge punishment; Indeed Lord observation

arabicExcerpts.text: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ

mainSubject.label: Oaths by the dawn, ten nights, the even and the odd, and the passing night — sufficient for one of perception; the Lord's dealing with Aad of Iram whose lofty pillars had no equal in the land, Thamud who carved rocks in the valley, and Pharaoh owner of the stakes, all of whom oppressed and spread corruption until a scourge of punishment was poured upon them — indeed the Lord is ever in observation
